sections.title: Page shell and early mode script
sections.what: Builds the full HTML frame: loads the fonts, runs a small script that applies the saved calm or nerd mode before anything shows, and places the page content and grain texture inside.
sections.why: The script runs before the first paint so a visitor does not see the wrong mode flash.
sections.watch_out: The script reads the key site-mode; renaming that key in the mode context without changing this script would reset visitors to calm.

summary: The root frame for every page: sets the language, title, description, theme colour, fonts and the early mode switch.
purpose: Provides the shared outer frame of the whole site, loads the fonts, and applies the saved calm or nerd mode before the page first shows.
why: The header of the inline script and its comment say it prevents a flash of the wrong mode on load.
how: 1) Sets the page metadata and theme colour. 2) Renders the document head with font links and a small script. 3) The script reads the saved mode from the browser and sets the mode attribute before paint. 4) Wraps the page in the mode provider and adds the grain texture layer.
inputs: The mode saved in the browser under the key site-mode, and the page content passed in as children.
outputs: The full HTML document shell used by every page.
risks: Fonts load from an outside service, so typography depends on it. If the saved key or its value changes, the fallback is calm. The script is a text string, so a typo fails silently.
debug: If the wrong mode appears, clear the saved site-mode value in the browser and reload. If fonts look wrong, check the font link loads. Hydration warnings are tolerated on the html element because the early script changes it before the app takes over.
